decision.reason: MTP2 completed the ten-request HTTP/SSE fixture with validation.passed=true and native exact-acceptance logging. Its sampled peak was 32393 MiB, leaving only 374 MiB free, below the predeclared 512 MiB safety gate; MTP5 was consequently skipped. The tool-call fixture remains a protocol failure because the payload was emitted in assistant content rather than an OpenAI tool_calls delta.

mtp5.reason: MTP2 minimum free VRAM was 374 MiB, below the 512 MiB post-warmup gate required before launching a larger draft arm.

quality.transport_validation: PASS: 10/10 HTTP 200, one [DONE] per stream, zero malformed SSE events, complete usage accounting, and finish_reason=stop.

semantic_fixtures.balance_scale_reasoning: PASS in both MTP2 runs: answer 2 with a valid two-weighing strategy
semantic_fixtures.vision_red_pixel: PASS in both MTP2 runs: Red
semantic_fixtures.required_tool_call: PAYLOAD_PASS_PROTOCOL_FAIL in both MTP2 runs: get_weather payload names Beijing but uses location; no OpenAI tool_calls delta was emitted, while the fixture schema requires city.

quality.mtp0_mtp2_parity: Semantic fixture intent matched 5/5, but byte-level output parity was not established: arithmetic, exact-instruction, and vision final-content hashes matched; reasoning hashes and the reasoning/tool outputs differed. The fixtures do not include a server-enforced deterministic seed.

performance.interpretation: MTP2 reduced wall time for the four text/tool fixtures in this paired smoke, while the vision fixture was slower and showed high run-to-run variance. This is a feature-smoke observation, not a sustained decode benchmark.

artifacts.mtp2_auxiliary_note: A prior same-fixture MTP2 run on build/apiserver_17a099ff also passed validation; it has no paired V100 sampler, so the named mtp2_vram artifact remains the safety-gate source of truth.

cutover_gates: Normalize the assistant-content tool payload into native OpenAI tool_calls and verify an end-to-end proxy tool round trip.
Keep MTP2 optional until a deterministic seeded parity test is available and the deployment free-VRAM margin is acceptable.
Do not launch MTP5 on this V100 arm without at least 512 MiB free after warmup.
Retain the native FastLLM backend; do not introduce llama.cpp.
negative_results: MTP5 was not run because MTP2 left 374 MiB free, below the 512 MiB safety gate.
MTP2 did not provide a byte-identical greedy output record against the prior MTP0 arm; the current fixtures lack a deterministic seed control.
The required-tool fixture remains protocol-incompatible despite a semantically recognizable payload.
Q8 composite size is 28.859 GB and leaves little headroom on a 32 GB V100; it is not a drop-in replacement recommendation for the existing Q4/Q6 decision.
